tickerText: [TENNIS] Novak Djokovic and Elena Rybakina head a 12-player panel confirmed Sept. 29 to advise the four Grand Slams on revenue share and player welfare after talks at the Laver Cup, with stars pushing for 22% of major-tournament revenue • [SQUASH] India's men's team topped Pool A with a 3-0 win over South Korea on Sept. 29 to reach the Asian Games quarter-finals, while the women beat Japan 2-1 as Tanvi Khanna clinched the decider against Akari Midorikawa • [BADMINTON] Asian Games singles finals day on Sept. 29 at Ichinomiya pits An Se-young against Akane Yamaguchi after the Korean routed Chen Yufei 21-5, 21-12, and Singapore's Loh Kean Yew faces Kunlavut Vitidsarn for historic men's gold • [PICKLEBALL] Day two of the Rate Las Vegas Open on Sept. 29 brings senior Open play and pro qualifying from 2 p.m. at the Darling Tennis Center, with 1,000 ranking points and Anna Leigh Waters two doubles titles from career No. 200 • [TABLE TENNIS] Lin Shidong closed the Asian Games program with a 4-0 men's singles final win over Wang Chuqin on Sept. 28, finishing with three golds and a team silver after 20 matches across four events in Toyota

newsItems.title: Djokovic Leads Slam Panel
newsItems.excerpt: A dozen players including Novak Djokovic and Elena Rybakina were confirmed Sept. 29 for a new Grand Slam advisory council after Laver Cup talks, as the group presses for about 22% of major revenue and stronger welfare support.

newsItems.title: Asiad Badminton Finals Day
newsItems.excerpt: An Se-young faces Akane Yamaguchi on Sept. 29 chasing the first back-to-back Asian Games women's singles gold, while Singapore's Loh Kean Yew meets Kunlavut Vitidsarn for men's gold after becoming his nation's first badminton finalist.

newsItems.title: Vegas Open Qualifying Day
newsItems.excerpt: The Carvana PPA Tour's Rate Las Vegas Open moves to senior Open brackets and pro qualifying on Sept. 29 at the Darling Tennis Center, with more than $1 million in payouts as top seeds fight for 1,000-point Open titles.

newsItems.title: Lin Shidong's Triple Gold
newsItems.excerpt: China's Lin Shidong swept Wang Chuqin 4-0 in the Asian Games men's singles final on Sept. 28 to cap three gold medals in Toyota, adding singles to his mixed and men's doubles titles after a 4-3 semifinal comeback over Lin Yun-ju.
